scope_note: General-purpose AI system obligations. Fields map to DataHub customProperties under the agentguard.eu_ai_act namespace.
known_limitations: agentguard.eu_ai_act.disclosure_compliant is currently derived from whether the asset presents authentication. Authentication is not a proxy for an Art. 50 transparency assessment, so this field can read 'true' for an asset whose findings show no AI-generated content disclosure. Treat it as a placeholder pending a real disclosure check.
agentguard.eu_ai_act.risk_category is derived from the automated risk tier, which weights authentication far more heavily than tool agency. Use it as a triage floor, not a legal classification.

assets.name: Ghost MCP
findings: No accountable owner registered (Art. 26 human oversight cannot be assigned).
Unauthenticated system-level access to filesystem and database.
Server is declared in configuration but unreachable: no operational logging (Art. 12).
assets.required_action: Decommission or re-authenticate and assign an owner before 2026-08-02.

assets.name: LangChain Agent
findings: Agent sends outbound email without a disclosure that content is AI-generated (Art. 50).
Shell execution tool grants agency beyond its documented purpose (Art. 9 risk management).
Three API credentials detected in the process environment.

Classified limited-risk because the automated tier derives from the risk score, which under-weights tool agency relative to authentication. The Art. 9 and Art. 50 findings above warrant a manual high-risk classification; automated tiering is a floor, not a substitute for assessment.
assets.required_action: Add AI-generated content disclosure to outbound channels; scope down shell access.

assets.name: Claude MCP
findings: Read access to source tree without authentication on a loopback port.
No access records retained for source files read by the model (Art. 12).
assets.required_action: Enable authentication and retain access logs for the read path.

assets.name: DataHub MCP
findings: Bearer authentication enforced; owner assigned; read-only metadata scope.
